_note: Copy this file to config/credentials.json (gitignored) and fill in the keys you use. The pipeline runs without credentials — TMDB entertainment data is skipped if absent, and deep-dive generation needs the Gemini key only when triggered.

tmdb._note: TMDB v3 API key. Get one at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api.

gemini._note: Google Gemini API key for on-demand deep-dive synthesis. Get one at https://aistudio.google.com (Get API key). Free tier covers gemini-2.5-flash. Or set GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment instead.
